# Como v Manchester Utd  (21/10/2026)

FavoritesSoccerTennisFootballBasketballBaseballHockeyGolf

Como prepare for arguably the biggest game in their history as they host three-time UEFA Champions League (UCL) winners Manchester United, who are desperately lacking in form.

## Match News and Current Form [...] Trevoh Chalobah was withdrawn early in Como’s weekend game, which Assane Diao sat out injured. Luke Shaw and Kobbie Mainoo have missed United’s last two matches, while Lisandro Martínez picked up a thigh problem on Sunday.

For all the latest team news, please check the Flashscore match centre.

## Betting Analysis

Como are sizable favourites, but their lack of European experience makes Manchester United in the double chance market a worthwhile consideration.

Author: Ryan Fisher

Loading... [...] United conceded 2+ goals in eight of their last ten UCL away fixtures.

## Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

Anastasios Douvikas netted in both of Como’s two UCL games this term and each of his last seven strikes for the club came beyond the half-hour mark. An unused substitute at the weekend, Marcus Rashford will be gunning for a potential 50th UCL appearance, with only three English players netting more than his 17 goals across their first 50 games in this competition.
